topic: Oral English: vowel sounds (choose the word with the same vowel sound as the letters in CAPITALS)

kept.q: Choose the word that has the same vowel sound as the letters in CAPITALS: PEN
kept.explanation: The word 'PEN' has the vowel sound /e/ as in 'pen'. 'SAID' is pronounced /sed/, which has the same /e/ sound. The other words have different vowel sounds.
kept.pidgin: 'PEN' get the /e/ sound. 'SAID' na /sed/, e get the same /e/ sound. The other words no match am.

kept.q: Choose the word that has the same vowel sound as the letters in CAPITALS: MOON
kept.explanation: 'MOON' has the long vowel sound /u:/. 'BLUE' is pronounced /blu:/, which carries the same /u:/ sound. 'BOOK' and 'GOOD' have the short /ʊ/ sound, while 'POT' has /ɒ/.
kept.pidgin: 'MOON' get long /u:/ sound. 'BLUE' na /blu:/, e get the same /u:/ sound. 'BOOK' and 'GOOD' get short /ʊ/, 'POT' get /ɒ/.

kept.q: Choose the word that has the same vowel sound as the letters in CAPITALS: CHAIR
kept.explanation: 'CHAIR' has the diphthong sound /eə/. 'THERE' is pronounced /ðeə/, matching this sound. 'FEAR' and 'HEAR' have /ɪə/, while 'STAR' has /ɑ:/.
kept.pidgin: 'CHAIR' get the /eə/ sound. 'THERE' na /ðeə/, e match am well well. 'FEAR' and 'HEAR' get /ɪə/, 'STAR' get /ɑ:/.

kept.q: Choose the word that has the same vowel sound as the letters in CAPITALS: BUS
kept.explanation: 'BUS' has the short vowel sound /ʌ/. 'LOVE' is pronounced /lʌv/, which has the same /ʌ/ sound. 'PUSH' has /ʊ/, 'BOSS' has /ɒ/, and 'PARK' has /ɑ:/.
kept.pidgin: 'BUS' get short /ʌ/ sound. 'LOVE' na /lʌv/, e get the same /ʌ/. 'PUSH' get /ʊ/, 'BOSS' get /ɒ/, 'PARK' get /ɑ:/.

kept.q: Choose the word that has the same vowel sound as the letters in CAPITALS: FEAR
kept.explanation: 'FEAR' has the diphthong /ɪə/. 'HERE' is pronounced /hɪə/, matching this sound exactly. 'HAIR' has /eə/, 'HER' has /ɜ:/, and 'HEART' has /ɑ:/.
kept.pidgin: 'FEAR' get /ɪə/ sound. 'HERE' na /hɪə/, e match am correct correct. 'HAIR' get /eə/, 'HER' get /ɜ:/, 'HEART' get /ɑ:/.

q.q: Choose the word that has the same vowel sound as the letters in CAPITALS: NEW
q.explanation: 'NEW' is pronounced /nju:/, with the sound /ju:/ (a 'y' glide before /u:/). 'FEW' is pronounced /fju:/, which has this same /ju:/ sound. 'BLUE', 'SOON', and 'MOVE' only have the plain /u:/ sound without the /j/ glide.
q.pidgin: 'NEW' na /nju:/, e get /ju:/ sound (with small 'y' before the /u:/). 'FEW' na /fju:/, e get the same /ju:/ sound. 'BLUE', 'SOON', and 'MOVE' just get plain /u:/ without the /j/.
